input: Source an illustrator for my children's book

gold.taskTitle: Source an Illustrator for Your Children's Book
gold.taskDescription: Find and hire a suitable illustrator to create artwork for the user's children's book project.

questions.title: What age group is your children's book aimed at?
questions.description: Understanding the target age range helps identify the right illustration style and complexity.

questions.title: What illustration style are you envisioning for the book?
questions.description: For example: whimsical, realistic, minimalist, watercolour, cartoonish, etc.

questions.title: How many illustrations does the book require?
questions.description: The total number of spreads or images will affect cost, timeline, and the type of illustrator to target.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the illustration work?
questions.description: Knowing the budget helps narrow down whether to approach freelancers, agencies, or platforms at different price points.

questions.title: What is your deadline for receiving the finished illustrations?
questions.description: The timeline determines urgency and how many candidates can realistically be considered.

questions.title: Do you have a self-publishing or traditional publishing deal in mind?
questions.description: The publishing route affects contract terms, rights ownership, and what an illustrator will expect.

questions.title: Have you already collected any reference images or style examples?
questions.description: Existing references will shape the brief and make it easier to evaluate and approach illustrators.
